senses.gloss: पिडक m. (and f(आ). ) a small boil, pimple, pustule, Rājat.; Suśr.
पीडक m. an oppressor (cf. तालु-प्˚).
पिड˚का-वत् and पिड˚किन्, mfn. having boils or pustules, Suśr.
पिड˚का-वत् and पिड˚किन्, mfn. having boils or pustules, Suśr.
पीड m. n. in तिल-प्˚, त्रिण-प्˚.
पीडा f. pain, suffering, annoyance, harm, injury, violation, damage (˚डया ind. with pain i.e. unwillingly), Mn.; MBh. &c.
devastation (cf. पीडन), W.
restriction, limitation, KātyŚr., Sch.
obscuration, eclipse (of a planet, cf. ग्रह-प्˚), Var.
pity, compassion, L.
a chaplet or garland for the head, L. (cf. आपीड)
Pinus Longifolia, L.
a basket, L.
w.r. for पीठ.
पीडन mfn. pressing, afflicting, molesting, paining (cf. चक्षु-प्˚)
पीडन n. the act of pressing or squeezing, R.; Kathās.; Gīt.
an instrument for pressing, press (= पीडन-द्रव्य), Suśr.
the act of oppressing or suppressing, paining, harassing, afflicting, R.; Kām.; Rājat.
devastation, laying a country waste, W.
misfortune, calamity, Mn. ix, 299
obscuration, eclipse (of a planet, cf. ग्रह-प्˚), Suśr.
suppression (of sounds, a fault in pronunciation), RPrāt.
पीडनीय mfn. used for pressing, serving for a press, Suśr.
= next, MBh.
पीडयितव्य mfn. to be oppressed or harassed or molested or pained, MBh.
पीडया ind., with pain i.e. unwillingly
पीडाय Nom. Ā. ˚यते, to feel pain, be uneasy, Sāṃkhyak., Sch.
पीडा—कर mfn. pain-causing, afflicting, tormenting, Yājñ.
पीडा—करण n. the causing of pain, torturing, W.
पीडा—कृत् mfn. = -कर, Var.
पीडा—कृत n. the infliction of pain or disadvantage, Gaut.
पीडा—गृह n. torture-chamber, house of correction, Sāy.
पीडा—भाज् mfn. showing wavy marks of pressure or indentations, Kir.
पीडा—यन्त्र-गृह n. = पीडागृह, Sāy.
पीडा—स्थान n. (in astrol.) an unlucky position, inauspicious distance (of a planet), Var.
पीडित mfn. squeezed, pressed, Mn.; MBh. &c.
hurt, injured, afflicted, distressed, troubled, badly off, ib.
covered, eclipsed, obscured, Var.
laid waste, W.
bound, tied, ib.
suppressed
badly pronounced, APrāt.
पीडित n. damage, Gaut.
harassment, annoyance, MBh. (v.l. पीडन)
a kind of coitus, L.
पीडितम् ind. closely, R.
पीडित—ता f.
पीडित—त्व n. the being pressed or afflicted or distressed, Suśr.
पीडिन् mfn. annoying, distressing (ifc.), Naiṣ.
